P.name: Cosmic Creator
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aurelion Sol's''' damaging [[champion ability|abilities]] against enemies generate him permanent stacks of {{as|Stardust}}, which gradually augments his abilities.
* ''{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'': Bursts deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
* ''{{ai|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}'': Range is increased by {{as|{{fd|7.5}} units per Stardust}}.
* ''{{ai|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}}'': Outer and inner radius increased equal to {{as|15% Stardust}}, and the execution threshold is increased.
* ''{{ai|Falling Star|Aurelion Sol}} / {{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'': Impact radius increased equal to {{as|15% Stardust}}.

Q.name: Breath of Light
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to {{fd|3.25}} seconds to exhale a beam of starfire, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. The beam collides with the first enemy hit to burn them, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and surrounding enemies every {{fd|0.125}} seconds. Secondary targets are dealt 50% damage.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|45/8 to 105/8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55/8}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}|{{tt|Total Maximum Magic Damage|Ranks 1-4}}|{{ap|(45/8)*26 to ((45+(105-45)*(3/4))/8)*26 4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(55/8)*26}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Secondary Target Damage per Tick|{{ap|(45/8)*0.5 to (105/8)*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(55/8)*0.5}}% AP)}}|Secondary Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|45*0.5 to 105*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*0.5}}% AP)}}|{{tt|Secondary Target Total Maximum Damage|Ranks 1-4}}|{{ap|(45/8)*26*0.5 to ((45+(105-45)*(3/4))/8)*26*0.5 4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(55/8)*26*0.5}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: Against the primary target, the beam will deal a burst of {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} for each full second that it burns them, and additionally generates {{as|2 Stardust}} if they are a {{tip|champion}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 100}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{ai|Cosmic Creator|Aurelion Sol|{{as|(+|hp}} {{as|({{fd|3.1}}% Stardust)}}{{as|%|hp}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|hp}}}}
Q.description3: ''Breath of Light'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
Q.description5: At rank 5, ''Breath of Light's'' channel duration is increased to 160 seconds.
Q.description6: ''If the channel is cancelled within the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds, Breath of Light is placed on a 1-second {{tip|lockout}} but does not go on cooldown.''
Q.costtype: Mana {{tt|(+ {{ap|30*0.25 to 50*0.25}} Mana per {{fd|0.25}} seconds)|Cost for mana per 0.25 seconds starts being paid after 1.25 seconds into the channel.}}

W.name: Astral Flight
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction and resets ''{{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}. During flight, he has {{tip|unobstructed vision}} and ''{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' has no cooldown and maximum channel duration and its non-burst flat damage is increased, but ''Astral Flight's'' dash speed is reduced by 50% during its channel.
W.leveling: {{st|{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}} Flat Damage Modifier|{{ap|108 to 112}}%}}
W.description2: '''''Aurelion Sol''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} crowd control during the dash.''
W.description3: ''Astral Flight'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the dash, and does so automatically upon arrival.
W.description5: Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them reduces ''Astral Flight's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 90% of its '''total''' cooldown.
W.description6: '''''Aurelion Sol''' will not dash after the cast time if he was {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} during it. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash. {{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}} channel will be interrupted if Astral Flight ends or {{ai|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}} or {{ai|Falling Star|Aurelion Sol}} / {{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}} is cast during the flight, but the ability will automatically be cast afterwards.''
W.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.4}}|Initial cast  (0.375, rounded to the next game tick)}}|{{tt|None|Recast}}}}

E.name: Singularity
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' conjures a black hole at the target location after a {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}-second delay|From start of cast time}} that lasts for 5 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area and dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies within.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|2.5 to 7.5}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|2.5*20 to 7.5*20}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*20}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: Enemies in the black hole are {{tip|kinematics|dragged}} inward until they reach the center, and {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} also have their {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' to a {{as|static 0|ms}}. Enemies within the center are {{tip|execute|executed}} below {{as|5%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.6}}% per 100 Stardust)}} {{as|of their '''maximum''' health}}, excluding epic monsters.
E.description3:
After ''Singularity'' ends, it generates {{as|1 Stardust}} for each full second that enemy champions were inside it, as well as varying amounts for enemy units that were killed while being within the area:
* Champions and epic monsters grant {{as|2 Stardust}}.
* Large minions and monsters grant {{as|2 Stardust}}.
* Small minions and monsters grant {{as|1 Stardust}}.

R.name: Falling Star
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' calls down a star that strikes the target location after {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second. This generates {{as|5 Stardust}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
R.description2: Once ''Falling Star'' has been learned, gathering {{as|75 Stardust}} causes the next cast of ''Falling Star'' to transform into ''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'', empowering the impact with new effects.

R.name: The Skies Descend
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' calls down a giant star that strikes the target location after 2 seconds, dealing {{ccs|25% increased damage|magic}} in a larger area and {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} enemies hit for 1 second.
R.description2: Additionally, the impact sends a massive shockwave that rapidly expands from the area over 3 seconds, dealing {{ccs|{{as|magic damage}}|magic}} to enemy champions and epic {{tip|monsters}} hit, {{tip|slow|slowing}} all enemies hit by 50% for 1 second, and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description3: ''Enemies hit by the star are immune to the shockwave.''
